cells.raw_text: No cardiac abnormalities detected; normal fetal growth and anatomy reported.
Male infant; birth weight 3.6 kg; Apgar scores normal; discharged as healthy.
Developed lethargy, decreased milk intake, and increased defecation frequency.
Symptoms worsened rapidly; admitted with acute heart failure; resuscitation failed; death occurred within 2 h.
Gross finding: cardiomegaly. Samples fixed in formalin due to pending legal/consent process.
Parents agreed to genetic testing after resolution of initial disputes.
Parents recalled; confirmed as carriers; initiated cardiac surveillance (mild mitral regurgitation noted).
Couple initiated IVF cycle with Preimplantation Genetic Testing (PGT).
hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HP:0001639), atrial septal defect (HP:0001631), acute heart failure (HP:0001635) [rowspan=4,colspan=1]

Age at diagnosis: 2 months, the neonate was found to have hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HP:0001639) and an atrial septal defect (HP:0001631), ultimately succumbing to acute heart failure (HP:0001635). Died aged 2 month [rowspan=4,colspan=1]
a HPO (Human Phenotype Ontology) provides a standardized vocabulary of phenotypic abnormalities to facilitate precise clinical description.

a PVS1 (Pathogenic Very Strong): Null variant (nonsense, frameshift, canonical ±1 or 2 splice sites, initiation codon, single or multiexon deletion) in MYBPC3 gene where loss of function (LOF) is a known mechanism of disease. PS4 (Pathogenic Strong): The prevalence of the variant in affected individuals is significantly increased compared with the prevalence in controls. PM2_P (Pathogenic Moderate - Supporting): Absent from controls (or at extremely low frequency) in population databases (e.g., gnomAD), used here as a supporting line of evidence.
